summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K furnishing notice of a related-party transaction under Article 33, item XXXII, of CVM Resolution 80/2022. Wholly owned subsidiary Voqen Energia Ltda. and co-controlling shareholder Petrobras executed Supply and Receipt Confirmation No. 11-2026 for natural gas delivered via title transfer at NTS, covering October 21-25, 2026, valued at R$7,530,250. Ten prior 2026 confirmations under the July 21, 2025 general terms agreement are itemized. No board recommendation, advisor, ownership change, or regulatory clock is implicated; this is routine gas procurement, not a special situation. Watch only related-party governance scrutiny.
